text: {"hypotheses":[{"statement":"Integrating MemGPT‑style virtual context paging (external memory with compression) into the bounded‑memory variant will preserve QA accuracy beyond the 40‑item threshold while keeping token usage under the simulation budget, effectively scaling the system to 100+ items without the accuracy drop seen in naive append.","confidence":0.78,"support_ids":["656e9540","a575e46b","dd46edef","6b6bffed"],"tags":["scalability","memory_consolidation","external_memory","token_budget"]},{"statement":"The accuracy degradation after ~40 items in the naive append baseline stems from representational interference, which can be alleviated by periodically compressing older facts into summary embeddings—as demonstrated by recent compression/consolidation papers and MemGPT—yielding flat accuracy across longer streams.","confidence":0.65,"support_ids":["656e9540","a575e46b","dd46edef"],"tags":["interference","compression","consolidation","accuracy_stability"]}]}
